subtopic: Trump Account Rules Before and After Age 18
source_evidence: After the child turns 18, most of the special rules no longer apply and traditional IRA rules generally apply.
question: Misconception: When a child turns 18, the special Trump Account rules continue unchanged.
answer: Correction: The source says that after the child turns 18, most special rules no longer apply and traditional IRA rules generally apply. It does not say that every special rule ends.
